Cusco · Perú

Cusco Cathedral

Stone portals and Cusco-school painting

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

The cathedral ensemble stands on the upper edge of the square. It is both a functioning church and a setting for Cusco-school painting. Compare the street façade with the scale of the nave, then choose one painting to study with its identification label.

Planning your visit

45–75 min · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

What to look for

Stone portals and Cusco-school painting

Step down into the plaza to keep the towers and the top of the portal within one frame. Interior works deserve time even when cameras are restricted.

Getting there

Get directions

History and local experience

Cusco-school painters worked within Christian subjects while using local workshops and visual conventions. Compare two paintings through gesture and dress before trying to cover every gallery.

Walking route

  1. Plaza de Armas, Catedral del Cusco
  2. View the complete front from across the square, go up to the posted visitor entrance and check the church’s service arrangements.
  3. Follow the interior circuit and keep the central aisle clear.
